SECTION D: Long Answer Type Questions (5 Marks Each)

Q31. (a) Define agriculture. Explain any four institutional reforms introduced by the 
government of India in the interest of farmers.  
OR  
(b) What is manufacturing? Classify industries on the basis of source of raw material.

Answer / Solution:
(a) Define agriculture. Explain any four institutional reforms introduced by the 
government of India. 
Definition: Primary activity producing food and raw materials. 
Reforms: 
1. Abolition of Zamindari: Removing intermediaries to give land rights to tillers. 
2. Consolidation of Holdings: To make land holdings economically viable. 
3. Kisan Credit Card (KCC): Providing easy credit to farmers. 
4. Crop Insurance: Protection against crop failure due to drought, flood, etc. 
OR (b) What is manufacturing? Classify industries on the basis of source of raw 
material. 
Definition: Production of goods in large quantities from raw materials. 
Classification: 
1. Agro-based: Use plant/animal inputs (Cotton, Sugar, Jute). 
2. Mineral-based: Use mineral ores (Iron and steel, Cement).
